item.title: Aijou Gakuen Machine Vibe ~Goku☆ugo! EX~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 01-Torte
  • 発売日: 2009-04-30
  • スコア: 6.32/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 愛嬢学園マシンバイブ ～極☆動!EX～
  • 英語名: Aijou Gakuen Machine Vibe Goku☆ugo! EX

别名

  • THE MACHINE BOY

あらすじ

One morning when I woke up, I found out both of my hands had turned into machine vibrators.

I covered my arms to hide this from other people, but Misa from the public morals department took offense at this and called me to see her. I asked her to let me off the hook, but she wouldn’t listen.

item.title: Gothdou no Otome-tachi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 01-Torte
  • 発売日: 2008-08-01
  • スコア: 6.51/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ゴス道の乙女たち
  • 英語名: Gothdou no Otome-tachi

あらすじ

It has been a week since the case of gothic loli rape case. Multiple loli have been assaulted at home and outdoors by either criminals or imitators.

Main character is a former basketball player with mediocre wits. He can’t solve this case on his own, so he asks Erica, gothic girl with scissors, for help.
